description: App feature demo in three sections with a reaction cut between each: app pt 1, reaction 1, app pt 2, reaction 2, app pt 3, then the branded outro. All three app slots scope to the brief's feature (subtype) via match_feature and dedupe against each other, so they draw three distinct clips of that feature. Order among the three app clips is by score, not by section number — tag each part's clip with a distinct shot_type and set prefer_subtypes per slot, or arrange them in edit mode, if a specific pt1/pt2/pt3 order matters. The two reactions carry an arc (intrigue, then delight) via slot emotions and are required, so a thin reaction library surfaces a clear insufficient_assets error rather than silently dropping a beat; relax to "required": false or swap emotions for match_mood if that library is thin. The outro is the cta slot: with_endcard on fills it with a branded end-card (rotating across the CTA folder); off, it closes on a topic clip with the generated CTA line. Set Feature (and optionally City/Mood) on the brief.

slots.notes: Section 1 of the app demo. match_feature scopes it to the brief's feature (subtype); dedupe keeps it distinct from the other two app slots.
First reaction, between sections 1 and 2 — the 'wait, what?' intrigue beat. Emotions set on the slot (not the brief mood) so the two reactions differ. Reactions carry no city, hence city_agnostic_ok.
Second reaction, between sections 2 and 3 — the delight beat that resolves the intrigue. Dedupe refuses to reuse reaction_1's clip or any sharing its checksum.
The outro. with_endcard on points this at the branded end-card (rotating across the CTA folder); off, it holds a topic clip behind the generated CTA line.

captions.notes: Names the feature. Dropped if the opening app clip has no subtype.

captions.pattern: Find it in Big City Travel Guide
